title: Fix Energy Weekly Schedule Weekday Slots
description: Fix the energy engine weekly-schedule weekday slot mapping. Date::day_of_week is 1=Sunday through 7=Saturday. weekly_value and the kernel index with min(day_of_week, 6), so slot 0 is never read and Friday shares Saturday's slot. Map onto the Sunday-first dailyScheduleIds order documented by the weekly schedule leaf (EnergyPlus Schedule:Week:Daily). Add a regression test, a language-agnostic fixture, and a honeybee comparison.
summary: Weekly schedule lookup now uses Sunday-first slots: day_of_week 1=Sunday maps to slot 0 and 7=Saturday maps to slot 6, in both ScheduleSet::weekly_value and the kernel. A fixture case, two Rust regressions, and a Honeybee Schedule:Week:Daily comparison lock the order.
